text:
maria: FYI customer reported a spike of 429s + intermittent 401s hitting model rwd-embed-64k during a prefetch/ingest job. They see errors when they ramp from ~30 -> 250 concurrent prefetch requests.

alex: Do we have the request_id or any example logs? 429 + 401 together usually means a mix of quota exhaustion + auth token rotation.

maria: Provided by customer: request_id=rc_20240425_9a7b, sample curl they used below. They said each request contains ~48k tokens of context and they fan out 8 embeddings calls per user.

maria: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXXX" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-64k","input":"<48k tokens>"}'\n```

priya: Quick checks: per-model limits for rwd-embed-64k are lower RPM/TPM and stricter concurrency than smaller models. Large-context requests consume more token units -> they hit TPM/RPM faster and likely trigger our per-model burst window.

jorge: @maria can you confirm if the customer is using a single API key shared across many processes? Shared keys aggregate against the same per-key quotas. Also ask them for the exact X-Request-Id header from one of the 429 responses.

maria: Sent follow-up asking for header dumps and whether they saw "x-rate-limit-remaining" or "x-model-quota" in responses. Customer attached a screenshot: 429 with headers: x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-model-capacity: throttled, and a 401 immediately after showing "token_expired" for a different request.

maya: Two things to mention in reply: (1) token rotation causing 401s is likely client-side; concurrent processes renewing tokens without coordination can cause transient 401s and retries that count toward quota. (2) For the 429s: reduce concurrency, add exponential backoff, or split the large context into embeddings batches.

alex: Also explain per-model RPM/TPM math: 48k tokens * 250 reqs/min => token rate can massively exceed TPM. Remind them tokens per request = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens; embeddings charge is based on input tokens.

priya: Suggested mitigations to send to customer:
- use a dedicated key per ingestion worker to avoid shared key hotspots
- implement jittered exponential backoff (start 200ms, max 10s)
- reduce parallelism from 250 -> 30 and measure effective throughput
- use prefix caching for repeated content to avoid re-embedding the same text
- if latency is critical, switch temporarily to rwd-embed-16k (lower per-request tokens) while we investigate

maria: Customer asked for reproducible steps to show us a failing trace. I asked them to run a short repro with these params and paste the raw response headers and body:

maria: ```bash
# run 60s flood test from one machine
for i in {1..250}; do \n  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n   -H "Authorization: Bearer <their_key>" \n   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n   -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-64k","input":"$(head -c 48000 /dev/zero | base64)"}' &\ndone\nwait\n```

jorge: Once we have a request_id we can map it in tracing to server-side throttles and see whether it was per-key RPM, per-model TPM, or our capacity fallback. If it's per-model we can show them the burst window behavior and recommended backoffs.

maya: I'll prepare a canned response and include mitigations + a short explainer about token accounting and per-model burst windows. Also include how to read our rate-limit headers: x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-remaining, x-rate-limit-reset, x-model-quota-state.

eng-oncall: Please escalate if customer is on a Dedicated plan or hitting production outage. @support-bot open ticket with severity=low->med (customer reports user-facing errors but app still partially functioning). Attach the traces once they send request_id.

support-bot: Ticket TCK-3491 created. Linking thread and requested artifacts. :white_check_mark:

alex: Final note for the response: ask them to include timestamps (UTC) of the observed 429 spikes, sample request IDs, and the API key id (we can map to customer org). Also recommend limiting fanout on prefetch during weekdays peak.

maria: Copying in recommended text to send to customer now. Will update thread when we get the request_id and server traces. :pray:
